tools.name: company_card
tools.description: Lead tool. Public-record company profile for a domain: legal name, domain age, registrar, LEI, socials; each field names its source. $0.03 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402

tools.name: page_meta
tools.description: Page metadata for one public URL: title, description, canonical, OG image, language, excerpt. $0.002 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402 Cheapest entry.

tools.name: structured_data
tools.description: Extract schema.org JSON-LD, microdata and OpenGraph from a page. $0.01 per call.

tools.name: link_graph
tools.description: Outbound links from one public page. Optional maxLinks is 1–50. $0.03 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402

tools.name: change_fingerprint
tools.description: Change fingerprint for one public URL: etag, lastModified, contentHash, byteLength, fetchedAt. $0.04 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402

tools.name: readable_text
tools.description: Main readable text from one public page. Optional maxChars is 1–12000. $0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402

tools.name: watch_page
tools.description: Watch a page for 7 days and get a webhook when it changes. $0.10 per watch.

tools.name: batch_meta
tools.description: Page metadata for 1–10 public URLs in one payment. $0.15 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "page_meta" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
